card.name: Unclear mix in old narrative prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on varied small words (you, be, sent, of, only, him) in older literary or historical prose, just before a verb or noun phrase.

modes.description: A pronoun or auxiliary word that comes before a verb of punishment or being called upon.
